$description: Telekom primitives: raw colour palette incl. brand magenta, dimension scale, type scale, radius, line weight, motion, opacity. Converted from github.com/telekom/design-tokens@882d939 (Telekom theme) to DTCG 2025.10.

brand.$description: Contrast with white is acceptable according to APCA for buttons, etc.

standard.$description: Defined by brand, can not be changed

standard_dark.$description: For dark mode with black background

font-scale.$description: Font scale is based on a formular: stepX = fontScale[x - 1] + (parseInt((x - 2) / 4) + 1) * 2; fontScale.push(stepX), where fontScale[0] = 10

125.$description: Not affected by the ratio, just a multiplier of the base value
